title: Production Intelligence Platform
shortDescription: A production tracking system designed to connect engineering, procurement, fabrication, quality control, and management workflows.
businessProblem: Production progress is often tracked through separate spreadsheets and manual departmental updates. This creates difficulties in understanding job status, identifying bottlenecks, and coordinating activities.
solutionSummary: A centralized production intelligence platform that organizes project stages, departmental workflows, and operational information.

maturityStatus.summary: Active pilot / in development, as reported in the project brief. Pilot deployment and capability scope have not been independently verified here.

architectureSummary.description: Conceptual layers from the existing project brief. These do not establish a deployed stack or implemented integrations.

limitations: Pilot status is an authored statement; no pilot acceptance record or operating deployment evidence was supplied.
Procurement visibility, quality inspection tracking and task ownership still require scope confirmation.

caseStudySections.title: What this brief establishes
paragraphs: The brief centers on equipment and job tracking, production stages, departmental views and BOM-based workflows. The portfolio sample demonstrates fixed job records and stage/owner views; it is not the pilot application or a live production feed.

assetRequirements: Permitted pilot screenshot of job tracking and departmental views
Recording of an actual stage change and BOM handoff, with version and scope
